tasks.description: Run the full Vitest test suite for the mini calculator project. Execute `npx vitest run` from the project root to run all test files: `src/App.test.tsx`, `src/components/Button.test.tsx`, `src/components/Calculator.test.tsx`, and `src/components/Display.test.tsx`. Report any failing tests with their error messages. All tests must pass with no failures or errors.
